hooks.name: whitelist_state_update
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's WhitelistToggleEvent)

rust_summary: The dedicated server whitelist was enabled or disabled (`native_whitelist_state_update`).
doc_summary: The dedicated server's whitelist changed state: `native_whitelist_state_update(enabled)` reports its final on/off state, after `/whitelist on` or `/whitelist off` from a player or console. Bundles need "hooks": @API:whitelist_state_update@.
